title: An infinite stable tournament has a transitive subtournament preserving a prescribed ordinal well-foundedness
source_title: Conservation of Ramsey's theorem for pairs and well-foundedness

standard_prerequisites.name: The SEM forcing and its main proposition
standard_prerequisites.statement: For a countable model of RCA_0 plus collection for Sigma^0_2 plus well-foundedness of the supremum of the ordinals omega to the natural product with omega below alpha, topped by a set Y, and for every set P Turing above the jump of Y with the model of P satisfying RCA_0^*, the forcing produces a set G which is an M-infinite transitive subtournament, computes the jump of G plus Y, and whose model satisfies RCA_0 plus collection plus WF(alpha); the author's own statement is retained at source lines 760-767.
standard_prerequisites.use: This is the statement the counted corollary specialises: the corollary drops the auxiliary set P by choosing it with the omega-extension theorem.

standard_prerequisites.name: Omega-extension of a model of RCA_0^* into a model of RCA_0^* plus WKL
standard_prerequisites.statement: Every countable model of RCA_0^* can be omega-extended into a model of RCA_0^* plus weak Konig's lemma; retained with this card at source lines 457-459.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof uses it to manufacture the set P above the jump of Y that the main proposition requires.

core_obligations: Use the omega-extension theorem to obtain a set P in the model such that P is Turing above the jump of Y and the model of P satisfies RCA_0^* (source line 1068).

Apply the main proposition of the SEM section, whose hypotheses are exactly the model hypotheses of the corollary together with that set P, to obtain a set G which is an M-infinite transitive subtournament, computes the jump of G plus Y, and whose model satisfies RCA_0 plus collection plus well-foundedness of alpha (source line 1069).
Read off the two items of the corollary: the transitivity and infiniteness of G, and the satisfaction of RCA_0 plus collection plus WF(alpha) in the model of G (source lines 1063-1064).

proof_roadmap.step: Produce the auxiliary set P with the omega-extension theorem.
Apply the main proposition and read off the two assertions of the corollary.
